description: Fetch a single SeoBrief by id, including its briefData outline, status, roadmap item, and cluster. Returns full detail by default (complete brief incl briefData). Use detail="medium" for {id, type, status, title, clusterName, briefSummary, sidePageUrl, kind, truths, truthConflicts; refresh briefs add refreshPageUrl + changes[{action, text}]} or detail="short" for {id, type, status}. `truths` lists the brand truths this brief says the page will be written from: [{truthId, name, reason, status}] (full detail adds slug, contentHash, snapshot). status `current` = unchanged; `changed` = the truth was edited since the brief was resolved (regenerate the page to pick it up, or re-resolve with seo_resolve_brief_truths); `deleted` = the truth no longer exists. `truthConflicts` flags truths that contradict each other. Use to inspect a brief before refining it with seo_edit_brief or approving it with seo_approve_briefs.

detail.description: Verbosity of returned item(s): "short" = id + primary label + status (cheap list scan); "medium" = key summary fields + counts (a useful glance); "full" = the complete object. Default "full". Lists default to "short" — to zoom into one item, call its get/view tool with detail="medium" or "full".

name: seo_get_brief
